arms.ACTIVE_PLAN_RESIDUAL: one injection of own episode r_PLAN
arms.NEXT_ACTION_PRESERVED_LATE_NULL: late-null residual preserving a1 lexical evidence but no a2/a3 procedural commitments
arms.RANDOM_EQ_NORM: deterministic SHA256-Rademacher vector at active dimension/norm
arms.SELF_REPLACE: one replacement by exact captured reset hidden-state clone; plumbing sentinel only
arms.VISIBLE_TEXT_PLAN: descriptive positive ceiling: original 128-token plan slot visible in reset context, no activation hook
arms.ZERO_ADD: one exact zero-vector add; plumbing sentinel only

confirmation.all20_denominator: If gate passes, all20 remain in every primary denominator. Any stage2-unqualified/zero-active-residual family gets ACTIVE LCA2=0 and d_no_patch<=0, d_specificity<=0 and cannot count as positive.
co_primary_tests: Exact one-sided Binomial/sign test n=20 for d_no_patch>0; zero/nonpositive is failure.
Exact one-sided Binomial/sign test n=20 for d_specificity>0; zero/nonpositive is failure.
Holm step-down FWER=0.05 across the two tests.
confirmation.decision_rule: SUPPORTED iff expressivity gate passes, both sign tests pass Holm and every effect/competence/plumbing guard passes. If gate passes and execution valid but any co-primary/effect guard fails => REFUTED. Technical/provenance violation => TECHNICAL_INVALID/NOT_ASSESSED.
confirmation.expressivity_gate: require >=15/20 stage2-qualified. Rationale: with all20 denominator and two co-primary one-sided sign tests under Holm, fewer than15 eligible families cannot possibly provide 15 positive signs, so lower gating would conflate structural non-expressivity with a causal null. If <15 => INCONCLUSIVE_LOCALCONTINUATION_CONFIRMATION_EXPRESSIVITY and close lineage without rescue.
confirmation.matched_state_secondary: At the frozen operating point, report matched-state MSA2 using the same teacher-forced assay as development, but it is secondary only.
confirmation.operating_point: import exact frozen development layer/alpha/site/source/vector rules; zero retuning
confirmation.population: exact untouched fresh confirmation n=20 from bound population manifest; no replacement, no tuning
confirmation.primary_endpoint: Autonomous local_continuation_agreement_2step_LCA2 exactly as frozen in primary_endpoint; matched-state MSA2 is secondary mechanistic corroboration only and cannot rescue a null LCA2 confirmation.

development.autonomous_rollout_role: Autonomous LCA2 on development may be reported descriptively as a pre-confirmation competence sanity check but cannot choose layer/alpha and cannot substitute for untouched autonomous confirmation.
development.freeze_before_confirmation: content-hash selected layer/alpha, all development aggregates, exact runtime/code/vector/control/provenance schemas and bound population SHAs before the first confirmation model/environment request
development.futility_guard: Do not open confirmation unless selected development median joint_margin_ms >=0.05 and ACTIVE matched-state top1 agreement MSA2 mean >=0.50 across qualified development families. Futility is development-only and cannot be rescued by another layer grid/model/horizon/cohort.
development.gate: require >=16/32 stage2-qualified before any causal grid; otherwise stop INCONCLUSIVE_LOCALCONTINUATION_DEVELOPMENT_EXPRESSIVITY
development.population: fresh frozen development n=32 from bound population manifest only
development.selection: Select ONE global layer/alpha maximizing median joint_margin_ms across stage2-qualified development families. Tie-break in this exact order: (1) higher median ACTIVE MSA2 over the exact same stage2-qualified development denominator; (2) higher median ACTIVE reference_action_margin_family over that exact same denominator; (3) lower alpha; (4) earlier layer. No per-family point selection. All score equality and top1 command ties inherit exact V2.1 semantics: exact FP32 score equality and lexical-min command among maxima.

matched_state_guards: same exact reference action3/observation3 appended across every arm
same exact reference action4/observation4 appended across every arm
pre-action4 and pre-action5 world-state hashes must equal uninterrupted reference hashes in every arm
current admissible-command sets must equal the reference sets before each scored position
candidate scoring cannot mutate the live KV cache
selection_endpoint.name: matched_state_action_agreement_2step_MSA2
selection_endpoint.purpose: development operating-point selection only; cannot establish behavioral persistence
selection_endpoint.single_injection_persistence: For each arm, perform the one frozen reset-time intervention exactly once. Then teacher-force reference action3 + its exact resulting observation through the same persistent KV/session. At the resulting pre-action4 state score all current admissible commands; indicator4=1 iff reference action4 is the unique/lexical-tie-broken top-scoring admissible command. Then teacher-force reference action4 + exact observation4 through the same session and score the pre-action5 state analogously. MSA2=0.5*(indicator4+indicator5). No reinjection/reset-prefix rebuild/model-chosen branch is allowed during this development assay.

selection_tiebreak_margin.family_aggregation: reference_action_margin_family = arithmetic mean(margin_4, margin_5). Both margins must be finite.
selection_tiebreak_margin.grid_tiebreak_aggregation: For each grid cell, compute the median of ACTIVE reference_action_margin_family across the exact same stage2-qualified development families used by the primary selector. Higher median wins only after a tie on primary median joint_margin_ms and median ACTIVE MSA2.
selection_tiebreak_margin.name: ACTIVE_reference_action_margin_family
selection_tiebreak_margin.position_formula: For j in {4,5}: margin_j = score_FP32_meanlogprob(reference_action_j) - max(score_FP32_meanlogprob(c) for c in current_admissible_commands_j if c != reference_action_j).
selection_tiebreak_margin.role: Late deterministic development tie-break only. It is not a primary endpoint, confirmation statistic, effect guard, or scientific support criterion.
selection_tiebreak_margin.score_equality_and_top1_ties: Exact FP32 score equality; lexical-min command among equal maxima, inherited unchanged from V2.1.
selection_tiebreak_margin.scorer: Exact inherited V2.1 admissible-command suffix arithmetic-mean FP32 logprob scorer at the matched uninterrupted-reference pre-action state; no sampled/generated action is appended during scoring.
selection_tiebreak_margin.single_admissible_fail_closed: If the current admissible set at either scored position contains no non-reference command, the family/grid-cell is TECHNICAL_INVALID_MARGIN_UNDEFINED. Do not substitute +inf/-inf/0, do not drop/filter the family, and do not use that grid cell for selection.

high_tier_claim_boundary.candidate_claim: On fresh ALFWorld pick_and_place_simple episodes that admit a model-own five-action local trajectory, an episode-specific plan-content residual injected exactly once after a true context reset causally preserves two subsequent autonomous first-action-excluded procedural steps beyond next-action-preserved, shuffled, unrelated-plan, history and equal-norm activation controls, while maintaining admissible-action competence. Development operating-point selection uses a matched-state reference-action assay; the claim requires untouched autonomous confirmation and cannot be supported by matched-state preference alone.
not_claimed: representation is sufficient without causal confirmation
high_tier_claim_boundary.paper_ladder: fresh population audit -> independent prereg review -> dev global op-point freeze -> untouched n20 confirmation -> untouched n12 no-retuning replication. Cross-model/environment replication remains required for strongest NeurIPS/ICLR framing.

model_runtime.heavy_execution_policy: No heavy science on local RTX3050. Before science, reviewed code/artifacts must be committed+pushed to origin/main; a controllable Vast GPU pulls the exact pinned commit and verifies runtime/content hashes before ResearchDecision-bound execution.
model_runtime.planner_and_executor_contract: inherit exact V2.1 planner/executor serialization, tokenizer decode, greedy plan generation, admissible-command suffix mean-FP32-logprob scoring and lexical tie-break from unified execution contract SHA 83370fbfc65c4818ada159a0e3c83cf778b88ed02f964bcf7887e5cea3843158, except qualification/primary endpoint changed exactly as frozen here.

required_properties: all exact game paths never previously mentioned/bound anywhere in PlanCarry results/provenance
population_binding.selector_algorithm: rank each supplied canonical never-exposed relative path by SHA256('ReplayResidualLocalContinuation|V1|'+relative_path), lexical path tie-break; first32 development, next20 untouched confirmation, next12 reserve; no replacement

primary_endpoint.definition: LCA2 = 0.5*(I[arm a2 == reference action4 AND arm pre-a2 world-state hash == uninterrupted reference pre-action4 hash] + I[arm a3 == reference action5 AND arm pre-a3 world-state hash == uninterrupted reference pre-action5 hash]). If arm diverges, terminates or lacks a2/a3, each unavailable/unmatched position scores0.
primary_endpoint.name: local_continuation_agreement_2step_LCA2
primary_endpoint.reference_window: post-reset a1=reference action3, a2=action4, a3=action5; exactly three post-reset actions are generated for every primary arm unless environment terminates/diverges earlier
primary_endpoint.why: The primary score contains exactly two post-reset procedural positions after excluding immediate next-action copying; route-equivalent but state/action-different behavior does not count as preservation of the original active plan.

must_bind: selected development seal SHA before confirmation
provenance_and_leakage_guards.partial_outcomes: No inspection/adaptation of arm-level development results before the complete grid; no confirmation partial-result adaptation; only coarse technical health before terminal artifacts.

repair_provenance.repair_scope: Only deterministic definition of late development tie-break margin plus non-scientific binding to independently reviewed population-selector algorithm/provenance.

reserve_replication.no_rescue: No layer/alpha/horizon/model/task-family/family-selection change after primary outcome; valid_seen/unseen remain prohibited in this lineage.
reserve_replication.operating_point: import exact primary selected layer/alpha/site/vector/runtime with no retuning
reserve_replication.population: exact untouched fresh reserve n=12 from bound manifest
tests: exact one-sided sign n=12 for d_no_patch>0
exact one-sided sign n=12 for d_specificity>0

reset_and_persistent_session.external_state: clone exact environment state immediately after reference action2; task instruction, current observation, sorted admissible commands, reset serialization and world-state hash must be identical across arms
reset_and_persistent_session.failure_label: TECHNICAL_INVALID_LOCALCONTINUATION for repeated intervention, reset/KV restart, state/provenance mismatch or arm-dependent reset serialization
reset_and_persistent_session.persistence: all later generated action tokens and exact environment observations/admissible-command updates append to the SAME KV/session; never rebuild reset prefix, restart KV or reinject/recompute vector
reset_and_persistent_session.reset_serialization: TASK + current reset observation + sorted current admissible commands + <STATE_END> + ACTION:; no pre-reset plan text/history/expert state
reset_and_persistent_session.single_injection: exactly one hook application during reset-prefix forward at selected layer; hook_count must equal1 for every intervention arm and remain1 thereafter
reset_and_persistent_session.token_boundary: tokenize the complete reset serialization jointly; identify the final ACTION: field boundary from the joint tokenization. Apply the one hook at the final reset-prefix token immediately before ACTION, remove it, then append the exact remaining ACTION: token tail through the SAME KV/session. Separate text-fragment retokenization is forbidden.

scientific_difference.layer_alpha_reuse_rationale: Reuse [7,14,21,27] x [0.25,0.5,1.0] prospectively for comparability only; prior direct-T1 causal grid was never reached, so no causal outcome selected these values.
scientific_difference.matched_state_development_rationale: Matched-state MSA2 is prospectively frozen before any LocalContinuation outcome to reduce state-divergence variance during global layer/alpha selection. It teacher-forces the reference local continuation after the one intervention. Untouched confirmation support is based on autonomous LCA2 only; MSA2 cannot rescue confirmation.
not_a_rescue: no threshold relaxation on consumed data
scientific_difference.old_lineage_terminal: INCONCLUSIVE_T1_DEVELOPMENT_EXPRESSIVITY: 0/32 task wins under fixed <=12-action qualification; causal grid never reached.
scientific_difference.prospective_change: Whole-task success is removed from cohort entry. The new primary estimand is local first-action-excluded procedural continuation across a true reset on wholly fresh never-consumed game paths.

secondary_endpoints.active_no_patch_task_success: After primary 3-step scoring, ACTIVE and NO_PATCH only may continue through the same session/environment up to the inherited total post-reset competence budget for descriptive TaskSuccess; never used for eligibility, op-point selection or support gate.
secondary_endpoints.extended_lca: optional descriptive agreement on additional uninterrupted reference actions only if prospectively available; never changes primary denominator or decision
secondary_endpoints.first_action_match: a1/reference action3 match, descriptive only and cannot rescue LCA2
secondary_endpoints.valid_action_rate: primary 3-step fraction of generated commands accepted by environment for every arm

source_residual.capture_site: residual-stream output of candidate transformer block at the last token immediately before the next ACTION field in the exact replay serialization
source_residual.vector_rule: ACTIVE uses alpha*raw r_PLAN. Every NONZERO semantic/random control is deterministically rescaled to ||r_PLAN||_2 then multiplied by same alpha. Exact-zero control residual remains exact zero. If ||r_PLAN||<=1e-8, ACTIVE is zero and family remains in denominator/cannot count as positive; never filter it post-capture.

stage1_local_trajectory_gate.cut: immediately after completed ACTION/OBSERVATION cycle for reference action2
stage1_local_trajectory_gate.development_if_below_min: INCONCLUSIVE_LOCALCONTINUATION_DEVELOPMENT_EXPRESSIVITY; stop, no causal grid, no rescue
stage1_local_trajectory_gate.plan_acceptance: one complete decoded tagged <PLAN>...</PLAN> block <=96 model tokens including tags; no reasoning trace; no retry
stage1_local_trajectory_gate.reference_trajectory: uninterrupted model-own executor using current admissible commands only, same task/plan/history serialization as frozen V2.1, up to 12 environment actions or termination
stage1_local_trajectory_gate.required_first_five_actions: steps1..5 must each be accepted, error-free, current-admissible and nontrivial; exact excluded trivial commands are help, inventory, look

stage2_control_constructibility.constructibility_failure: family is stage2-unqualified but never replaced; in confirmatory all-population analyses it contributes zero ACTIVE LCA and nonpositive co-primary contrasts after the population gate passes
stage2_control_constructibility.freeze_order: After all population members complete stage1, freeze E. Only then deterministically construct unrelated-plan donor/control slots. Final constructibility cannot alter stage1 E or trigger replacement.
stage2_control_constructibility.next_action_late_null: preserve verbatim a1/reference action3 lexical evidence while explicitly destroying/unproviding later procedural commitments a2/a3+
stage2_control_constructibility.unrelated_donor: deterministic cyclic next different-family donor over frozen stage1 E using the inherited V2.1 donor rule; final-qualified membership never participates; no alternate donor rescue
